reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-09-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
months AS (  -- one row per cohort month
  SELECT DISTINCT cohort_month
  FROM cohort
),
active AS (  -- one row per cohort user and month with an activation event
  SELECT DISTINCT c.user_id, c.cohort_month,
         date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', e.event_ts) AS DATE)) AS month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN activation_events e ON e.user_id = c.user_id
)
SELECT m.cohort_month, k.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN m.cohort_month + INTERVAL (k.month_offset) MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE COUNT(a.user_id) END AS active_users
FROM months m
CROSS JOIN range(0, 3) AS k(month_offset)
LEFT JOIN active a ON a.cohort_month = m.cohort_month AND a.month_offset = k.month_offset
GROUP BY m.cohort_month, k.month_offset

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per user who signed up in the cohort months
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', signup_ts) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-09-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
grid AS (  -- one row per cohort month and month offset from 0 to 2
  SELECT DISTINCT c.cohort_month, g.month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 2) AS g(month_offset)
)
SELECT g.cohort_month, g.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN g.cohort_month + INTERVAL (g.month_offset) MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id)
                  FROM cohort c
                  JOIN activation_events e ON e.user_id = c.user_id
                  WHERE c.cohort_month = g.cohort_month
                    AND date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(e.event_ts AS DATE)) = g.month_offset) END AS active_users
FROM grid g

            ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.user_id)
                  FROM cohort c
                  JOIN activation_events e ON e.user_id = c.user_id

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT user_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', signup_ts)) AS DATE) AS cm FROM signups
  WHERE signup_ts >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-09-01 00:00:00+00' AND signup_ts < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00'
),
a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.cm, c.user_id,
         date_diff('month', c.cm, CAST(date_trunc('month', timezone('UTC', e.event_ts)) AS DATE)) AS mo
  FROM c JOIN activation_events e ON e.user_id = c.user_id
),
cells AS (
  SELECT d.cm, k.month_offset, CAST(d.cm + to_months(CAST(k.month_offset AS INTEGER)) AS DATE) AS mstart
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cm FROM c) d CROSS JOIN range(0, 3) AS k(month_offset)
)
SELECT x.cm AS cohort_month, x.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN x.mstart >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(a.user_id) END AS active_users
FROM cells x
LEFT JOIN a ON a.cm = x.cm AND a.mo = x.month_offset
GROUP BY x.cm, x.month_offset, x.mstart
